title: Thrad Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Thrad adapter

publisherId.description: Selects which Thrad Publisher's API key pair to use (pbs.yaml adapters.thrad.extra_info's publishers map). Set to our own Publisher.slug, e.g. sayhola, drawify, learnrithm, artsmart, slashspace.

requestType.description: Bid request type: contextual (default) or opener

userId.description: Anonymous user identifier, injected per-auction from window.tpc.data

hashedEmail.description: Logged-in user's SHA-256(trim(lowercase(email))) hex, hashed publisher-side; protocol 2 only (user.extended_ids.emails_sha256). Optional.

userMetadata.description: Optional user targeting and compliance metadata

protocol.description: Ignored: the adapter speaks v2 only since v1's removal (2026-11). Still accepted because Stored Imps carry it from the per-placement migration; remove once they drop it.

placementId.description: Stable placement id sent to Thrad v2 as opportunities[].id (Thrad's reporting placement). Filled automatically from the Stored Imp id by tpc.paramfanout; may be set explicitly.
